labels.note: LRU popitem no longer removes the item or returns a pair; eviction in __setitem__ loops forever.
RR popitem no longer removes anything; eviction breaks and loops forever when the cache is full.
Timed-cache pop no longer removes the item or returns its value; TTL/TLRU eviction breaks too.
Heap cleanup triggers at the exact 2x boundary too; only performance or unspecified iteration order changes.
cache_info().maxsize attribute access raises AttributeError; breaks the public namedtuple API.
cache_info().currsize attribute access raises AttributeError; breaks the public namedtuple API.
The 'in' operator turns None into False; only a direct __contains__ call returns None.
TTL popitem no longer removes anything; eviction in __setitem__ loops forever when the cache is full.
